description: Browse a big categorized bank of kaomoji faces — click any face to copy it instantly.

faqs.a: Happy, Sad, Love, Angry and Surprised — 15 or more faces in each, 90+ total.
Click any kaomoji to copy it to your clipboard, then paste it anywhere.
faqs.q: How do I copy a face?
How are kaomoji different from emoji?
faqs.a: Kaomoji are text faces typed with keyboard characters, like (^_^). They work anywhere plain text works, with no special font needed.
